args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest newsletter covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to a blog article and offering free email registration for a companion piece.
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots cut claims by a quarter (accessed via registration with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example).
